comparison.objective: Clamp a pan and plate together, invert them bimanually, release the cake, and remove the pan. Candidate adjusts and locks an industrial damper, then validates carriage stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires opposed-side bimanual clamping, coordinated inversion of a loose stack, placement, regrasping, and pan removal. Candidate requires recessed hex-key use, counterholding, fine collar adjustment, relocking, control pressing, and iterative dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires cake inverted >160°, centered on a plate and stand, pan ≥13 cm away, and 2 s stillness. Candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J stops without exceeding 12 mm stroke, striking the hard stop, rebounding excessively, overloading, or drifting.
comparison.reason: The record tests maintaining a loose multilayer stack during inversion and separation; the candidate tests mechanical tuning and retention under repeated impact. Bimanual handling alone is generic. Candidate leaves rebound, overload, drift, and witness-torque thresholds incomplete.
